verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Probes found HTTP 404 for /llms.txt and for a markdown version of the bizfile docs, and the evidence documents no agent-oriented documentation. The bizfile portal also serves a bot-management shell even for robots.txt, so an agent cannot read it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
